title: Outbound Announcement V1
description: What a store attached to a backbone announces for each locally authored event: every operation exactly once. A batched gesture announces exactly the operations it appended — a coalesced gesture amends the tail edit the previous gesture already announced, so it announces only its own operations, never the tail edit's earlier ones (a hub refuses a re-announced, already accepted operation as a replay). An undo announces its one history transition. Every announced operation — a batched gesture's like any other — names as `observed` the newest operation of another author the store had applied when it was authored; `observed` is advisory, so a replica applies a remote operation whose observation it never saw at once, never holding it back.

coalesceKey.description: The gesture's undo coalescing key; `null` never amends.

items.description: How many mutations the gesture folds into its one edit.

Expect.title: Announcement And Ledger After The Step

edits.description: Edits in the history ledger after the step.

tailOperations.description: Operations of the tail applied edit after the step (0 when nothing is applied).

observed.description: The `observed` every operation this step announced carries (`null` when it announced none or observed no foreign operation).

remote.title: Remote Operation
remote.description: One operation of another author arriving over the backbone, with the observation its author stamped.
